Scene shifts to black and white, emphasizing Retsuko's change in mood and foreshadowing her transformation.

activities.description: Retsuko jumps across rooftops, reaches a streetlight, waits impatiently at a crosswalk, runs through an alley, and slips on a banana peel.

characterInteraction.description: Haida is still trailing behind, mostly observing Retsuko's actions.

Exaggerated sound effect when Retsuko slips on the banana peel adds humor.
